stemMd: A mutation prevents delivery of hydrolytic enzymes to lysosomes but leaves mitochondrial respiration normal. Which process is most directly impaired?

options.label: D
options.textMd: Breakdown of material delivered to lysosomes

explanationMd: Lysosomes digest macromolecules using hydrolytic enzymes. Losing those enzymes directly impairs intracellular digestion, whereas DNA replication, translation and ATP generation use other machinery.

distractorRationale.b: DNA synthesis occurs through different enzymes.
distractorRationale.a: The spindle is not assembled by lysosomal hydrolases.
distractorRationale.c: The stem explicitly leaves mitochondrial respiration normal.
distractorRationale.e: Lysosomal hydrolases do not catalyse translation.
